en: A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a narrow-gauge railway track running through dense banana and coffee plantations. Several people, including men in hats and traditional clothing, stand along the track amidst tall banana plants. Mountains are faintly visible in the distance. Handwritten-style text along the bottom identifies the scene and location, and there is a photographer's credit on the lower right.
